basic_info.description: Live ‘La Vie en Rose’ at 241 Paris Street in this handsome  urban oasis with potential ADU level. A suave 5BR, 5BA residence in SF’s vibrant Excelsior District, this turnkey property is both beautiful and practical. The top 2 floors feature 3 ensuite bedrooms and den  & guest full bathroom. Open concept kitchen/living/dining room with extra tall ceilings, built ins and fireplace suited for modern living. The ground floor features 2bd 1ba , wet bar/kitchenette and its own separate entrance. Ideal for multi-generational living, rental income/airbnb, nanny quarters….or use this floor as deluxe rumpus /media / recreational level.  Extras include garage with interior access, large welcoming front porch, & beautiful, terraced backyard for entertaining and lounging. 95 WalkScore: near parks , schools,  dozens of restaurants, 2 BART stations, easy 280 freeway access.  Ample size , convenient location , move-in condition and bonus level for extra room or rental income. A rare San Francisco opportunity that hits all the marks.
